scanner: scripts/official-source-recheck.py equivalent: HTTP GET, redirects followed, text SHA-256 baseline (no earlier baseline existed, so this scan sets it)
scope: every official-source URL pinned in release/*.json for the 27 configured markets
honest_limits: Reachable means the page answered with a non-error status; it does not mean the legal text on it was re-read in full.

Pages that answered 403/401, TLS-chain errors, timeouts or resets could not be re-verified from the scan environment; their evidence is carried forward from the 2026-10-01 screening and is listed under cells_without_reachable_source.
This ledger is the first content baseline: later scans compare text hashes against it.
